recipes.name: Schweddy Balls inspired by Saturday Night Live
ingredients: 2 packages (8 oz) cream cheese, room temperature
To taste freshly ground black pepper
Optional: to taste hot sauce of choice
4 oz powdered sugar + more for coating
3/4 oz cocoa powder + more for coating
3 tbsp light corn syrup or honey
instructions: For the Popcorn Balls
Heat coconut oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. - 3 tbsp coconut oil
Add 2 or 3 kernels and once the kernels pop, add all the remaining kernels. - ½ cup popcorn kernels

Cover the pot with a lid and let sit for 30 seconds off the heat. Shake the pot if necessary to make sure all of the kernels come in contact with the hot oil. Once you hear consistent popping, continuously shake the pot until all of the kernels have popped, about 3 minutes.

Transfer the popcorn to a large bowl and season with 1 teaspoon of kosher salt. Make sure to remove any unpopped kernels now. Also add the peanuts to the bowl. - 1 tsp kosher salt divided - ⅔ cup peanuts
Combine the corn syrup, sugar and water in a small saucepot. - ¾ cup light corn syrup - ¾ cup granulated sugar - ¼ cup water
Bring the mixture to a boil and cook until the syrup reaches 235 °F.
Add the vanilla extract and remaining teaspoon of salt to the syrup and then, pour it over the popcorn. - 1 tsp vanilla extract - 1 tsp kosher salt divided
Using a plastic spatula, fold the popcorn until the syrup is well distributed.
Allow the mixture to cool until it is handleable, about 2-3 minutes. Meanwhile, coat your hands/gloves in nonstick spray
Scoop mounds of popcorn mixture, then roll them into spheres.
Let the popcorn balls cool completely before serving.
For the Classic Cheese Balls

Combine the cream cheese, cheddar cheese, parmesan cheese, scallions, Worcestershire sauce, lemon zest, garlic powder, onion powder, oregano, salt, pepper, and hot sauce (if using) in the bowl of a stand mixer. - 2 packages (8 oz) cream cheese room temperature - 6 oz sharp cheddar cheese grated - 2 oz parmesan cheese grated - 2 scallions thinly sliced - 1 ½ tsp Worcestershire sauce - 1 Zest of lemon - ½ tsp garlic powder - ½ tsp onion powder - ¼ tsp dried oregano - To taste kosher salt - To taste freshly ground black pepper - Optional: to taste hot sauce of choice
Using the paddle attachment, combine until the cheese mixture is homogenous, about 2-3 minutes.
If the cheese is too soft to handle at this time, refrigerate the mixture for 10-15 minutes.
Separate the mixture into two or four equal size balls. Roll the cheese spheres in the chopped pecans. - 1 cup pecans toasted + roughly chopped
Serve immediately with crackers or refrigerate until ready to serve.
For the Rum Balls

Combine the pecans, wafers, powdered sugar, and cocoa powder in a large bowl. - 4 oz pecans roasted + finely chopped - 8 oz vanilla wafer cookies ground - 4 oz powdered sugar + more for coating - ¾ oz cocoa powder + more for coating
In a separate bowl, combine the rum and light corn syrup. - 4 oz dark rum - 3 tbsp light corn syrup or honey
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients. The mixture should form a wet sand consistency. If the mixture is too dry, add the water. - 1 oz If needed water
Roll the mixture into golf-ball-sized spheres. Coat the 3D circles in more powdered sugar or cocoa powder. - powdered sugar + more for coating - cocoa powder + more for coating
Serve immediately or store in an airtight container.
